name: Zapier MCP Server Setup & App Authorization
summary: Configure a central Zapier MCP Server on mcp.zapier.com to expose native integrations (Gmail, Sheets, Slack) as structured MCP tools for AI agents.
steps: Navigate to mcp.zapier.com and create or select an MCP server configuration (e.g., Codex MCP Server).
Click '+ Add apps' to connect target services including Gmail, Google Sheets, Slack, Canva, and AI by Zapier.
Authenticate app connections and verify granular action counts (e.g., Google Sheets 36 actions, Gmail 22 actions).
Copy the MCP server connection endpoint into the target agent environment.
jarvis_use: Expose Zapier's 9000+ app connectors directly to Jarvis via a standard MCP server instance.

name: High-Reasoning Model Preset Selection in Codex UI
summary: Select an advanced reasoning model preset (e.g., GPT-6 Astra Extra High) inside the Codex interface context prior to initiating multi-step automation generation.
steps: Launch Codex desktop/web client connected to local OS overlay.
Locate the model selection dropdown menu at the top of the interface.
Select the targeted high-capacity model preset ('GPT-6 Astra Extra High').
Verify sidebar chat context is active and connected to MCP servers.
jarvis_use: Ensure high-capacity reasoning model presets are selected when delegating complex architectural tool builds.

name: Automated Missing-Skill Fallback via Plugin-Management
summary: Catch missing MCP tool calls during agent execution and automatically route to a plugin-management skill to load required integrations without terminating the run.
steps: Detect failure when an agent attempts to call an un-loaded tool skill (e.g., `zapier:build-workflows`).
Trigger fallback execution using the local `plugin-management` skill.
Query connected MCP servers to locate and authorize the missing integration.
Complete OAuth browser authentication if prompted, then resume workflow execution.
jarvis_use: Enable self-healing tool discovery in Jarvis when requested skills are not pre-loaded into active memory.

name: OAuth SSO Browser Popup Interception in Agent Runs
summary: Pause agent tool execution to handle single sign-on (SSO) browser pop-up authentication when connecting SaaS service accounts mid-task.
steps: Receive authentication challenge when agent attempts to authorize a Zapier MCP connection.
Open popup window to `zapier.com/login` displaying SSO options (Google, Microsoft, SSO, Email).
Complete the authentication flow in the browser UI.
Return auth tokens to the agent session to resume multi-turn execution.
jarvis_use: Handle required human-in-the-loop OAuth SSO prompts gracefully during autonomous tool provisioning.

name: Natural Language Agent Workflow Construction Prompt Pattern
summary: Structure a detailed single prompt directing an AI agent to build, sample-test, verify, publish, and link a complete multi-app workflow via `zapier:build-workflows`.
steps: Specify the primary trigger app and event (e.g., watch Gmail for receipt/renewal emails).
Define exact data extraction fields (vendor, amount, currency, billing cycle, date, category).
Specify destination logging target and currency normalization rules (e.g., Google Sheets in USD).
Set conditional alert rules (e.g., email user only if charge >= $50 or billing cycle is annual).
Include exclusion constraints (e.g., filter out self-addresses and automated loop senders).
Require real historical sample testing, verification of live outputs, publishing, and URL reporting.
jarvis_use: Formulate structured prompts when asking Jarvis to build complex multi-app automations end-to-end.

name: Autonomous Agent Data Verification & Historical Sampling Loop
summary: Run an extended agent loop (13m+) that samples real historical inbox emails to test extraction accuracy before publishing live workflows.
steps: Agent queries connected Gmail account to locate real historical receipt samples (e.g., Apple, OpenAI, Elementor).
Agent executes test extractions against no-reply senders, foreign currency receipts, and annual renewal notices.
Verify row formatting and alert condition evaluation against sample data.
Confirm trigger is claimed and active before publishing live Zap.
jarvis_use: Verify Jarvis automations against real historical data samples before turning on production triggers.

name: Subscription Receipt Extraction & USD Currency Normalization Pipeline
summary: Automate parsing of incoming Gmail subscription receipts, extracting key metadata, converting foreign currencies to USD, and logging to Google Sheets.
steps: Set Gmail search trigger to watch for incoming receipt and renewal notice emails.
Use AI parsing step to extract vendor name, amount, original currency, billing cycle, next charge date, and category.
Convert extracted foreign currency amounts into USD using daily reference exchange rates.
Check for duplicate rows before inserting structured data into Google Sheets.
jarvis_use: Track subscription expenses automatically across email receipts and log standardized USD costs.

name: Sender Self-Address Exclusion Rule to Prevent Infinite Loops
summary: Configure explicit trigger-level email sender exclusions to filter out self-directed messages and system feedback addresses.
steps: Identify sender addresses that could trigger recursive loops (e.g., user's own email address or system bot IDs).
Add an explicit filter step to check incoming `From` headers against the exclusion list.
Halt execution if sender matches excluded addresses; proceed only for external vendor receipts.
jarvis_use: Guard against infinite notification loops in email-triggered Jarvis agents.

name: Multi-Condition Filtering for High-Value & Annual Renewal Alerts
summary: Apply conditional filter rules in cloud automations to send immediate email notifications only when transaction threshold or cycle criteria are met.
steps: Receive extracted fields from AI parsing node (amount in USD, billing cycle type).
Evaluate conditional rule: IF amount >= $50 USD OR billing cycle == 'annual'.
IF rule evaluates to TRUE -> trigger immediate alert email to user.
IF rule evaluates to FALSE -> skip email step and complete background spreadsheet logging.
jarvis_use: Prevent email notification spam by filtering alert outputs based on financial cost and billing frequency thresholds.

name: Autonomous Zapier Workflow Verification via Zapier UI Graph
summary: Inspect the visual step node graph inside the Zapier Workflow editor to confirm agent-built logic tree accuracy and live activation status.
steps: Open generated workflow URL (`zapier.com/workflow/01a0a1df...`).
Inspect the assistant badge panel showing 'Built with Codex - it's live'.
Review each node step (Parse AI analysis, Filter criteria, Action creation, Validation).
Confirm that triggers and publishing switches are toggled to active.
jarvis_use: Inspect and audit Zaps created autonomously by Jarvis inside the visual Zapier editor interface.

name: AI Email Inquiry Handling with Slack DM Operator Notification
summary: Build an automated inquiry processing pipeline that extracts email intent, drafts a response in Gmail, and sends a notification DM to Slack.
steps: Parse incoming customer email intent and extract key inquiry fields.
Filter out non-inquiry emails using rule-based criteria.
Generate a structured email reply draft inside Gmail for operator review.
Compose and send a Slack direct message with Gmail conversation links and draft summary.
jarvis_use: Automate draft creation for inbound customer communications while pinging operator via Slack DM for review.

name: Macro Network Knowledge Graph Integration (AI Workshop OS)
summary: Map automation bridge nodes into a visual dark-mode graph UI (AI Workshop OS at localhost:4719) to maintain architectural visibility across tools.
steps: Launch local web visualization server at localhost:4719.
Define macro hubs (Skill Suites, Email Funnel, Zapier, Kit, Gmail).
Attach metadata tooltips to node connections detailing underlying MCP capabilities.
Inspect force-directed graph to trace data flows between community funnels, email tools, and local business scripts.
jarvis_use: Visualize Jarvis's active MCP integrations, sub-agents, and data funnels in a centralized interactive node graph.

name: Zapier Open Source MCP Integration Stack Deployment
summary: Deploy open-source repositories (`zapier-mcp`, `zapier/sdk`, `zapier/connectors`) to interface local AI coding agents directly with Zapier's backend API infrastructure.
steps: Clone `https://github.com/zapier/zapier-mcp` into the agent tool directory.
Utilize `zapier/sdk` to expose custom app connector endpoints.
Bridge agent MCP protocol client to Zapier connector definitions.
Verify tool resolution during agent task initialization.
jarvis_use: Use open-source Zapier MCP tooling to bridge Jarvis directly to external cloud SaaS ecosystems.
